phrases: You're not dead. You still feel everything.
Now you're nothing but décor of lethal lust.
You're a hanging collection of holes, strung together by nerves.
You can't close your legs, even if you want to. You can't even shut your eyes.
Now the demon will feed on your mind, forever.
You're still alive — but doomed to eternal suffering.
You're just meat that feels every touch.
You're still alive, and a quick death isn't coming for you.
Cut into pieces — still alive. A perfect composition of flesh and pain.
Your arms, legs, and head are just fruit on a demon's tree now.
You've been filled completely — now you're just my vessel, hanging on threads.
